create_time.Description:
Output only. The creation time of the table. A timestamp in RFC3339 UTC
"Zulu" format, with nanosecond resolution and up to nine fractional
digits. Examples: "2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and
"2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z".

database.Description: The id of the parent database.

delete_time.Description:
Output only. The deletion time of the table. Only set after the
table is deleted. A timestamp in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format, with
nanosecond resolution and up to nine fractional digits. Examples:
"2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z".

etag.Description:
The checksum of a table object computed by the server based on the value
of other fields. It may be sent on update requests to ensure the client
has an up-to-date value before proceeding. It is only checked for update
table operations.

expire_time.Description:
Output only. The time when this table is considered expired. Only set
after the table is deleted. A timestamp in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format,
with nanosecond resolution and up to nine fractional digits. Examples:
"2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z".

parameters.Description:
Stores user supplied Hive table parameters. An object containing a
list of "key": value pairs.
Example: { "name": "wrench", "mass": "1.3kg", "count": "3" }.

storage_descriptor.Description: Stores physical storage information on the data.

input_format.Description: The fully qualified Java class name of the input format.

location_uri.Description: Cloud Storage folder URI where the table data is stored, starting with "gs://".

output_format.Description: The fully qualified Java class name of the output format.

table_type.Description: Hive table type. For example, MANAGED_TABLE, EXTERNAL_TABLE.

name.Description:
Output only. The name of the Table. Format:
projects/{project_id_or_number}/locations/{locationId}/catalogs/{catalogId}/databases/{databaseId}/tables/{tableId}

update_time.Description:
Output only. The last modification time of the table. A timestamp in
RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format, with nanosecond resolution and up to nine
fractional digits. Examples: "2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and
"2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z".
